question: Which list correctly gives the four names of the child in Isaiah 9:6?
options: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace
Holy One, Mighty King, Good Shepherd, Lamb of God
Son of Man, Living Bread, True Vine, Bright Morning Star
Lion of Judah, King of Kings, Lord of Lords, Word of God
explanation: Isaiah 9:6 names him Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
